key.name: default-level
key.summary: Signature level selected by default (DP-04)

key.name: pdf-format
key.summary: Signature format for PDF documents

key.name: xml-format
key.summary: Signature format for XML documents

key.name: other-format
key.summary: Signature format for other files

key.name: output-suffix
key.summary: Suffix of the signed file name

key.name: output-directory
key.summary: Folder for signed files; empty means the folder of the original

key.name: digest-algorithm
key.summary: Hash algorithm of new signatures

key.name: tsa-url
key.summary: URL of the time-stamping authority (DP-02)

key.name: tsa-auth
key.summary: Authentication with the time-stamping authority

key.name: network-timeout
key.summary: Seconds to wait for a network response
key.description: Read timeout. Connecting always waits at least 20 seconds, to cover the SYN retransmissions seen on the RENIEC network (R-17).

key.name: proxy-mode
key.summary: Proxy configuration

key.name: proxy-url
key.summary: Proxy URL in manual mode

key.name: visible-signature
key.summary: Make signatures visible by default

key.name: appearance-kind
key.summary: Appearance of visible signatures: text, rubric, logo or QR code (RF-012)
key.description: The rubric and the logo are images loaded once in the preferences.

key.name: appearance-language
key.summary: Language of the fixed texts and the date of visible signatures (RF-092)

key.name: appearance-dni
key.summary: How visible signatures show the DNI: last four digits, full or not at all
key.description: The certificate in the signed PDF carries the full DNI anyway; this only concerns the printed stamp and its QR code.

key.name: appearance-profile
key.summary: Default appearance profile of visible signatures

key.name: signature-reason-kind
key.summary: Last signature reason chosen from the list

key.name: signature-reason
key.summary: Text of the last "Other" signature reason

key.name: signature-location
key.summary: Last signature location used

key.name: recent-locations
key.summary: Signature locations used last, most recent first (up to five)

key.name: history-enabled
key.summary: Keep a history of operations

key.name: history-full-path
key.summary: Store the full path of files in the history, not only their names (AM-12)

key.name: pkcs11-module
key.summary: PKCS#11 module; empty means automatic detection

key.name: token-backend
key.summary: How to talk to the card: by its ATR, the DNIe v2 driver or PKCS#11

key.name: crl-fallback
key.summary: Download CRLs when OCSP fails during verification
key.description: The CRL of the CA that issues DNIe certificates is about 109 MB.

key.name: ui-language
key.summary: Language of the interface (ADR-0015)

key.name: report-language
key.summary: Language of exported PDF reports
